# 1. NETTOYAGE PRÉLIMINAIRE

## 1.1 Retirer les colonnes vides et hors module

```{r PA_T0}

Famille <- readr::read_csv("/Users/alicethomassin/Documents/Scolarité/Muco 2026/data_hors_git/clean_data/THOA_famille_1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

vars_parents <- Famille %>% 
  select(pf_pere_prenom, pf_pere_mois_nais, pf_pere_an_nais, pf_pere_decede,
         pf_pere_mois_deces, pf_pere_an_deces, pf_pere_etudes, pf_pere_prof,
         pf_pere_statut, pf_pere_entreprise, pf_pere_qual, 
         pf_mere_prenom,
         pf_mere_mois_nais, pf_mere_an_nais, pf_mere_decede, pf_mere_mois_deces,
         pf_mere_an_deces, pf_mere_etudes, pf_mere_prof, pf_mere_statut,
         pf_mere_entreprise, pf_mere_qual,
         pf_union_parents, pf_union_mois, pf_union_an, pf_parents_interromp,
         pf_interromp_par, pf_interromp_mois, pf_interromp_an,
         pf_raison_muco) %>% 
  colnames()


PA_T0 <- Famille %>% 
  select(id_date_creation, fa_date_creation, id_anonymat, id_sep, id_sexe, 
         id_date_nais, fa_commentaires = commentaires_fam, all_of(vars_parents)) %>% 
  mutate(
    nb_NA_total = rowSums(is.na(across(all_of(vars_parents)))),
    .after = id_date_nais
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    fa_pa_complet = case_when(
      nb_NA_total == length(vars_parents) ~ "0",
      TRUE ~ "1"
    ),
    .after = id_date_nais
  )


```
